name: stack-test-pro-android
description: Stack Test Pro Android / Capacitor package

scripts.android:init: npm run web:prepare && cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:prepare && cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && node scripts/build-android.mjs debug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && node scripts/build-android.mjs release
